declared: 2026-11-16, before any fit of FastTNet v3
purpose: Combine v1's compact stride-4 FastTNet inductive bias (which achieved 0.601 Note F1 / 0.719 Onset F1 on Vocadito singing) with calibrated training (no +0.9 eval logit bias, pos_weight=5.0, warmup + cosine LR decay, weight decay, gradient clipping, 2 seeds), training on all 525 HumTrans train clips without val_int early-stopping.
data_hygiene: Train ONLY on all 525 HumTrans training clips (F01-F05, M01). Select calibrated threshold on tr[:80] matching v1's protocol over expanded grid [0.20..0.90] step 0.05. Test ONLY on Vocadito training-role windows (33 usable windows with >=3 A1 onsets across 14 singers; 39 manifest windows) and HumTrans development person M02 (64 clips). M03-M05, VALID, TEST untouched.

architectures.transformer_v3: Exact FastTNet from declaration_e2e.json (d=32, nhead=4, nlayers=2, stride=4, 4 fine_convs dilations (1,2,4,8), 47.2k params) with eval_logit_offset=0.0 (removing the hardcoded +0.9 eval logit bias).

feature_sets.full: pitch, reliable flag, confidence, z-scored log-energy, onset score (+ boundary track for augmentation_only and bpdr); nin=5 or 6
feature_sets.lean: pitch, reliable flag, confidence only (+ boundary track for augmentation_only and bpdr); nin=3 or 4

training_and_calibration.lr_schedule: 20-step linear warmup from 0.1*lr to lr, followed by cosine annealing from 3e-3 to 3e-4
training_and_calibration.loss: BCEWithLogitsLoss(pos_weight=5.0) on soft targets (1.0 center, 0.5 neighbors) over valid frames across (X, XB, Xd), plus BPDR probability L1 consistency terms (weight 10.0) for the bpdr arm
training_and_calibration.threshold_selection: Select threshold in THRS maximizing mean onset F1 at 50 ms on tr[:80] at end of training (step 300).
training_and_calibration.fit_health: Healthy if tr[:80] Onset F1 at 50 ms >= 0.9x extractor baseline on tr[:80].

adoption_bar.studio_default: Adopt v3 as Studio's default checkpoint only if v3 (full frame_only, 2-seed mean) has non-saturated thr (< 0.85) and matches or exceeds v1 on Vocadito Note F1 & Onset F1 without regressing on dev_M02.
adoption_bar.checkpoint_export: Save best full frame_only checkpoint (by trF1) to results/studio/r1/boundary_transformer_v3.pt, best full bpdr checkpoint (by trF1) to results/studio/r1/boundary_transformer_v3_bpdr.pt, and metadata JSON to results/studio/r1/boundary_transformer_v3_meta.json.
